statements.text: Folk psychology is the everyday framework used to explain and predict intelligent behavior. On the theory-theory it consists of generalizations, such as that someone who desires X and believes doing Y is the best way to get X will tend to do Y, and of theoretical posits named by everyday terms like belief and pain, which are assigned causal, semantic and qualitative properties.

sources.quote: Folk psychology is assumed to consist of both generalizations (or laws) and specific theoretical posits
If someone has the desire for X and the belief that the best way to get X is by doing Y, then (barring certain conditions) that person will tend to do Y.
